ui.browser.attention.heading.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.browser.attention.heading.note: Small label above the sidebar's list of browser notifications: things an agent's browser tab is waiting on the user to do (answer a password manager, open a sign-in window, approve site access). The user opens each when they choose.

ui.browser.attention.passkey.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.browser.attention.passkey.note: A password manager's passkey/sign-in prompt appeared in a tab an agent is driving; the agent is paused until the user answers it. Use the locale's usual term for 'password manager'.
ui.browser.attention.passkey.length: Short; one line in a ~220px sidebar row, may truncate.

ui.browser.attention.popup.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.browser.attention.popup.note: A sign-in (login) window that a web page opened in an agent's browser tab is held hidden until the user opens it.
ui.browser.attention.popup.length: Short; one line in a ~220px sidebar row.

ui.browser.attention.site_access.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.browser.attention.site_access.note: An agent asked permission to act on a website as the user; the user approves or denies it in the browser's approvals card.
ui.browser.attention.site_access.length: Short; one line in a ~220px sidebar row.

ui.browser.attention.no_site.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.browser.attention.no_site.note: Shown in place of a website address when the waiting tab has no web address yet (blank page).

ui.browser.attention.detail.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.browser.attention.detail.note: Second line of the row. {site} is a website host name (e.g. example.com); {session} is a conversation title or a phrase like 'An agent'. Keep the middle dot separator.

ui.browser.attention.open_label.role: accessible name (aria-label) of a clickable notification row
ui.browser.attention.open_label.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.browser.attention.open_label.note: Read by screen readers. {need} is one of the notification titles; {site} a website host; {session} a conversation title. 'Open it' means clicking takes the user to that browser tab.

ui.browser.attention.more.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.browser.attention.more.note: Last row of the sidebar's browser notifications when more than three are waiting; clicking opens the Browser view, which lists them all. 'Browser' is the name of the app's Browser destination in the sidebar; use the same word as that destination.
